nks, disk, credentials — redacted report for Discussions.
# dsh-doctor
One-command health check for a DeepSeek Harness installation.
When a DSH install misbehaves, the interesting facts are spread across the home directory: which pro
file launched, whether every bundle in `dsh.profile.bundles` still resolves, whether a `link:` depen
dency points at a moved checkout, whether the patch layer still parses, whether the volume has room
left. `dsh_doctor` collects those facts read-only and returns a redacted Markdown report that is saf
e to paste into a Discussion thread.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The package is plain ESM with no build step, so a git install needs no build-script allowlist. Pinni
ng a commit (`github:Bliveren/dsh-doctor#<sha>`) prevents a later push from changing what runs.
Restart the host, then ask the agent:
> Run dsh_doctor and show me the report.
## What it checks
| Check | What it answers |

| `runtime/node` | Is the running Node.js inside the supported range? |
| `profile/exists` | Does th

e launched profile directory exist? |
| `profile/manifest` | Does the manifest declare a readable `d

sh.profile.bundles` list? |
| `bundle/<name>` | Per bundle: in-box or installed, patch file present,

`engines.dsh` satisfied |
| `profile/patch` | Does `cordis.patch.yml` parse, and does it contain du

plicate row ids? |
| `profile/local-links` | Do `link:` and `file:` dependencies still point at some

thing? |
| `profile/backups` | Leftover `.bak-*` files and abandoned `<profile>.broken-*` copies |
|

`profile/lockfile` | Is the profile's dependency set pinned? |
| `home/exists`, `home/writable` | D

oes the DSH home exist and accept writes? |
| `home/disk` | Free space on the DSH home volume |
| `h
ome/credentials` | Is `.credentials.yaml` present, and are its permissions restrictive? |
In-box bundles (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`, …) resolve from the dsh install
ation rather than the profile, so their absence from the profile's `node_modules` is not a problem.
A bundle counts as in-box when the profile manifest does not list it under `dependencies`.
## Parameters
- `profile` — profile name to inspect. Defaults to the profile the host was launched with, detected
from the launcher's profile-directory argument or `DSH_PROFILE`.
## Example report
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## What it does not do

- It never reads credential contents. Only presence and permission bits are reported.
- It never wri

tes, repairs, or deletes anything. Fixes appear as hints, not actions.
- A pass is not a guarantee o
f a working install. The checks cover layer composition and filesystem state; runtime behavior (prov
ider reachability, sandbox availability, plugin internals) is outside this tool.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The checks live in `lib/checks.js` as pure functions over paths and process facts, so new checks are
testable without booting DSH. `index.js` only wires them into the tool registry.
